question: Should OpenClaw add configured emoji-list selection to the existing initial acknowledgment contract?
rationale: The implementation boundary is clear, but this expands a public cross-channel configuration surface, and no maintainer decision establishes whether selection should be random, deterministic, or content-aware.

options.title: Approve local emoji lists
options.body: Accept strings or non-empty lists at existing precedence levels and resolve one reaction locally without an additional model call.

options.title: Retain singular acknowledgments
options.body: Keep the current initial reaction contract and use lifecycle status reactions for varied automatic feedback.

options.title: Design contextual strategy separately
options.body: Defer content-aware selection to a typed rule or agent-hook proposal rather than coupling it to this immediate acknowledgment path.

recommendation.title: Approve local emoji lists
recommendation.body: Accept strings or non-empty lists at existing precedence levels and resolve one reaction locally without an additional model call.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the current public per-channel acknowledgment contract and are the strongest available routing candidate for deciding whether to extend it.
